environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on an EC2 instance running Amazon Linux 2, process runs as 'appuser' with read access to the filesystem. Application serves on port 3000 behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). No filesystem isolation. The /etc/shadow, /etc/passwd, /proc/self/environ, and application secrets in /opt/app/.env are all readable by the process.
